main_text.head: SECVNDA PARS PHYSICÆ,
main_text.p: Hæc secunda pars agit de Mundo, de Cœlis & Astris, de Elementis, de Mixtis, Inanimatis, & de Anima.
main_text.head: CAPVT PRIMVM
De Mundo.
main_text.p: 1. MVNDVS est collectio omnium corporum rectè dispositorum; corpora sunt instar materiæ[?], & recta eorum dispositio instar formæ: corpora simplicia scilicet cœli & elementa pertinent ad perfectionem mundi essentialem, mixta ad accidentalem tantum; alioquin cum mixta pareant, mundus essentialiter mutaretur.

2. Mundus ectypus est mundus corporeus & sensibilis; archetypus vero & intelligibilis est mundus idealis, scilicet Deus; in quo est exemplar & idea mundi ectypi: Mundus magnus est mundus sensibilis continens omnia corpora; parvus vero est homo; in quo sunt omnia entium genera, cum habeat esse cum

page.notes: The Google watermark at bottom right is excluded. The page number is read as 55 but may be 35. "materiæ" is partly covered by an ink blot, so the letters "ri" are doubtful. "rectè" is partly obscured. "dispositio" is hard to read at the line break and may read "dispsitio" in print. "ectypus" is printed in italics and could be read as "ectypus" or "eftypus". The top of the page has a decorative ornament and a divider line, which are not printed text.
